questions.stem_text:
If the government regulates a monopoly to produce at the allocative efficient quantity,
which of the following would be true?

options.A: The monopoly would make an economic profit.
options.C: The monopoly would increase its prices.
options.D: The deadweight loss in this market would increase.
options.E: The deadweight loss in this market would decrease.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - The deadweight loss in this market would decrease.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following statements about a price ceiling is accurate?

options.A: A price ceiling will have no effect on the quantity of the good supplied.
options.B: A price ceiling will cause a shift in the supply curve for the good.
options.C: A price ceiling always results in a surplus of the good.
options.D: A price ceiling will increase the total revenue of buyers.
options.E: An effective price ceiling must be at a price above the equilibrium price.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - A price ceiling will have no effect on the quantity of the good supplied.

questions.stem_text:
The United States produces rice in a competitive market. With free trade the world price
is lower than the domestic price. What must be true?

options.A: The United States begins to import rice to make up for a domestic shortage.
options.B: The United States begins to export rice to make up for a domestic shortage.
options.C: The United States begins to import rice to eliminate a domestic surplus.
options.D: The United States begins to export rice to eliminate a domestic surplus.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The United States begins to import rice to make up for a domestic shortage.

questions.stem_text: If the Federal Reserve was concerned about the "crowding-out" effect they could engage in

options.A: expansionary monetary policy by lowering the discount rate.
options.B: expansionary monetary policy by selling Treasury securities.
options.C: contractionary monetary policy by raising the discount rate.
options.D: contractionary monetary policy by lowering the discount rate.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - expansionary monetary policy by lowering the discount rate.
